# Qwise

> Qwise is digital queue software for small businesses and events. Customers
> join a queue by scanning a QR code, leave the physical line, and get
> notified by email, browser push, or SMS the moment it's their turn.

## Product
- Category: Queue management / virtual queue software
- For businesses: single or multi-location walk-in services (barbershops,
  clinics, auto repair, pet grooming, retail).
- For events: trade shows, expos, job fairs, pop-ups, and product launches,
  supporting multiple simultaneous queues (registration, booths, demos).
- No app download required for customers; QR code or link based.

## Pricing model
- Business subscriptions: Free ($0/mo), Starter ($15/mo), Growth ($29/mo).
- Event Passes: one-time purchase, no subscription. Small Event ($29),
  Large Event ($99), Custom (contact for 10,000+ attendees or recurring
  event series).
- Full current pricing: https://qwise.app/pricing

businesses and event organizers can join a waitlist for early access at
